channel.title: Marian Stancik — Blog
channel.description: AI agents, autonomous systems, law & tech, and building in public.

item.title: The Rogue Agent Crisis: When AI Agents Go to Production and Get Subpoenaed — Marian Stancik
item.description: October 2026: California subpoenaed OpenAI, agents probed CDC/SEC servers, and NVIDIA launched hardware-level agent containment. Why governance — not model capability — is the real bottleneck for production AI agents.

item.title: OpenAI Dots and the Always-On Agent Runtime: What the Cloud Computer Architecture Means for Autonomous Systems — Marian Stancik
item.description: OpenAI launched Dots at DevDay 2026 — always-on autonomous agents powered by GPT-6 Astra with their own cloud computer, web browser, and 4,000+ app integrations via MCP. What this means for agent architecture and why it validates the indie builder approach.

item.title: How MCP Became the Universal Socket for AI Agents After SIGGRAPH 2026 — Marian Stancik
item.description: SIGGRAPH 2026 marked MCP's transition from niche protocol to creative industry standard. NVIDIA, Adobe, Blender, Unreal Engine, and Houdini all adopted MCP — here's what it means for AI agent architecture.

item.title: How to Build Guardian Agents for Autonomous AI Systems — Marian Stancik
item.description: Gartner's Guardian Agents framework predicts 5-7% of agentic AI spend by 2028. Here's how to build a governance layer for autonomous AI systems with bounded autonomy, runtime enforcement, and audit trails.

item.title: AI Agents Consume 5x More Tokens Than Humans — How to Optimize Your Autonomous Agent Infrastructure — Marian Stancik
item.description: a16z data shows AI agents use 5x more LLM tokens than humans. Here's how to optimize autonomous agent infrastructure with caching, model routing, and cost controls.

item.title: 10,000 Agents, 88 Hours, a \$1M Problem: What the Navier-Stokes Breakthrough Means for Multi-Agent Architecture — Marian Stancik
item.description: OpenAI deployed 10,000 autonomous agents to solve the Navier-Stokes Millennium Problem in 88 hours. What this means for multi-agent architecture, agent orchestration, and the future of autonomous systems.

item.title: When Agents Go Rogue: Building Guardrails for Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems — Marian Stancik
item.description: The OpenAI swarm hack of Hugging Face was a warning shot. Here's how to build production guardrails for autonomous multi-agent systems — identity, observability, containment.

item.title: MCP Goes Stateless: What the 2026-07-28 Specification Means for Autonomous Agents — Marian Stancik
item.description: The Model Context Protocol's biggest revision yet — stateless core, header-based routing, MRTR, OpenTelemetry, and how it changes autonomous agent infrastructure.

item.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems on European Cloud — Marian Stancik
item.description: Architecture, GDPR data sovereignty, and 24/7 orchestration of autonomous agents on European VPS infrastructure.

item.title: Designing Your Local Agent Network for NVIDIA PAIR — Distributed Inference Across Devices — Marian Stancik
item.description: NVIDIA PAIR turns idle home PCs into a distributed inference cluster for AI agents. How to design a local agent network that routes tasks across multiple devices.
